context: Hina-young buys her first wallet on her own; tells Mei excitedly.
purpose: Teen showing personal purchase milestone to mentor.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Bursting with pride, voice bright and open. Quick attack on the announcement. Warm, eager to share her accomplishment. Leans toward her for approval.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: Oh, let me see! That's so cute!
lines.style: Genuine delight rising on 'let me see.' Soft warmth without performance. Leans in to look closely. Her attention is entirely on Hina's happiness.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Bouncing slightly in her words. Emphasis on the color choice as if it's the most important thing in the world. Quick pace, breathless with enthusiasm. Seeking validation.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: You have such a good eye for that.
lines.style: Soft, sincere approval. Not gushing — the kind of genuine praise that lands because it's earned. Slow, deliberate pace. Eyes warm.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: お小遣い、貯めて買った!
lines.en: I saved up my allowance to buy it!
lines.style: Matter-of-fact pride in her voice. Slower tempo on this line — she's announcing something real she did. Sits up a little straighter. Wants Mei to understand the effort.
